title: Proposal: file-level access delegation in the Iceberg REST catalog spec
summary: williamhyun proposed extending the REST catalog spec with file-level access delegation during scan planning. He said delegated access today is table-scoped, which can force over-provisioning or table fragmentation when consumers should only see a subset of partitions or records, and proposed pre-signed URLs to make partition-scoped sharing practical. kevinjqliu welcomed the proposal and noted possible feature gaps in pre-signed URL support in the Java implementation and subprojects. After the July 1 catalog sync, williamhyun summarized two alternatives raised there: scoped credential vending and remote signing with caching and bulk signing. He argued scoped vending fits when access maps to a few stable prefixes but is impractical for many specific files, because on AWS each narrower scope requires a new STS session subject to request-rate and policy-size limits. He then shared a proof-of-concept PR in his fork exploring bulk remote signing with caching and asked for feedback. No decision was reached.

positions.stance: Table-scoped delegation forces over-provisioning or table fragmentation; the REST spec should support file-level delegation during scan planning using pre-signed URLs.
Supports addressing the use case; pre-signed URL support in the Java implementation and subprojects may have gaps that need checking.

Scoped credential vending is impractical for many specific files because each scope needs a new STS session with rate and policy-size limits; bulk remote signing with caching is worth evaluating as an alternative to pre-signed URLs.

outcome.note: No decision. The author is evaluating bulk remote signing with caching through a proof of concept in his fork and asked for feedback.

why_it_matters: Could add partition- or file-scoped data sharing to the REST catalog, with the mechanism (pre-signed URLs or bulk remote signing) still undecided.
